name: @caveman-ai/cli
description: Caveman CLI — wrap coding agents with recoverable local context compression and truthful metering (`caveman claude`), then drive Caveman Cloud from terminal. Compression and metering run in companion Go binaries: run `caveman setup` to see install state. Local savings stay inferred until verified.

scripts.build: node scripts/gen-binaries.mjs && node scripts/gen-wedge-installer.mjs && node scripts/compile-registries.mjs && tsc && node scripts/bundle-delegate.mjs && node scripts/bundle-tui.mjs && node scripts/shebang.mjs
scripts.test: node scripts/gen-binaries.mjs && node scripts/gen-wedge-installer.mjs && node scripts/compile-registries.mjs && tsc && node scripts/bundle-delegate.mjs && node scripts/bundle-tui.mjs && node scripts/shebang.mjs && node --test --test-concurrency=4 tests/*.runtime.mjs
scripts.test:fast: node scripts/gen-binaries.mjs && node scripts/gen-wedge-installer.mjs && node scripts/compile-registries.mjs && tsc && node scripts/bundle-delegate.mjs && node scripts/bundle-tui.mjs && node --test --test-concurrency=4 --test-reporter=dot tests/agent-native.runtime.mjs tests/billing.runtime.mjs tests/capability-config.runtime.mjs tests/login.runtime.mjs tests/mcp-surface.runtime.mjs tests/porcelain.runtime.mjs tests/practice-registry.runtime.mjs tests/skills.runtime.mjs tests/status.runtime.mjs tests/subscription-recovery.runtime.mjs tests/wrap-gate.runtime.mjs
